claim_text: The records New Mexico seeks are the redacted materials in the federal 'Epstein Library', compiled under Section 2(a)(1)-(9) of the Epstein Files Transparency Act, Public Law 119-38 (19 November 2025).
quote: we seek the redacted materials contained in the USDOJ's 'Epstein Library,' compiled pursuant to Section 2(a)(1)-(9) of the Epstein Files Transparency Act, Public Law 119-38 (Nov. 19, 2025)
confidence_justification: The request names the statute and section it runs against. This is what ties the New Mexico case to the separate question of federal compliance with that Act.
